topic: Three construction details of Noahs ark in Genesis, and how later illustrations differ from the text
researchKind: Public YouTube recent interest sample; not keyword search volume
decision: Noahs ark has the highest median observed view velocity in this query sample. Do not copy the high-performing alleged-discovery/proof/podcast angles: our angle follows biblical text and clearly attributed historical interpretation. Channel size, clickbait, format and recent news can explain much of this signal.
